title: U.S. EPA Enforcement and Compliance History Online (ECHO) - All Data

operations.description: Based on the QID obtained from a get_facilities or get_facility_info query, return a comma separated value (CSV) file of the facilities found.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] echo rest services download [PARAMS] output p pretty print qcolumns qid [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Validates query search parameters and returns query identifier.  Use the responseset parameter to set the page size
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] echo rest services facilities [PARAMS] 1 1lat 1lon 2 2lat 2lon 4 5yr 80cnt act addr agoo c callback co cs ct ejscreen fa fac fea feaa feac feay ff fips fn fntype frs huc ico icoo icos iea ieaa ieay impw istatute lat limit long mact maj maplist med naa ncs neiu ocr oct output over p pd pen pid pm qcolumns qiv qs queryset radius reg responseset sa sfs sic st summarylist tablelist trep tribedist tribeid tribename usmex wbd ysl ysla ysly zip [SCHEMA] 0 1 data ers facilities map output results

operations.description: Returns either an array of Facilities or an array of Clusters that meet the specified search criteria.
operations.summary: Combined ECHO Facility Enhanced Search Service
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] echo rest services facility info [PARAMS] 1 2 4 5yr 80cnt act addr agoo callback co cs ct ejscreen fa fac fea feaa feac feay ff fips fn fntype frs huc ico icoo icos iea ieaa ieay impw istatute lat limit long mact maj med naa ncs neiu ocr oct output over p pd pen pid pm pretty print qcolumns qiv qs radius reg responseset sa sfs sic st trep tribedist tribeid tribename usmex wbd xmax xmin ymax ymin ysl ysla ysly zip [SCHEMA] 0 2 cluster data ers facilities output qp results

operations.description: Based on the QID obtained from a get_facilities or get_facility_info query, return GeoJSON of the facilities found.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] echo rest services geojson [PARAMS] callback descending newsort output p pretty print qcolumns qid [SCHEMA] 5 ers feature geo properties

operations.description: Based on the QID obtained from a clustered get_facility_info query, download cluster facility information as either a CSV or GEOJSON file.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] echo rest services info clusters [PARAMS] output p pretty print qid [SCHEMA]

operations.description: The purpose of the GET_MAP service is to display facility coordinates and facility clusters related to a get_facilities facility query. Currently, the maximum number of coordinates returned is 500. GET_MAP performs automatic clustering at the state, county, and zip code levels to maximize the number of coordinates returned.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] echo rest services map [PARAMS] 1 2 c callback id lat long output p qid tablelist [SCHEMA] 0 data ers map output

operations.description: GET_QID is passed with a query ID corresponding to a previously run get_facilities query. It then returns a Facility object containing all matching facilities. The main purpose of GET_QID is for large querysets that contain multiple pages (responsesets) of output. GET_QID allows for pagination and for the selection and sorting of columns.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] echo rest services qid [PARAMS] callback descending newsort output pageno qcolumns qid [SCHEMA] 1 4 ers facilities results

operations.description: Returns the JSON Object Name and ColumnId for usage with the qcolumns parameter for get_qid, get_facility_info and other service endpoints.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] echo rest services metadata [PARAMS] callback output [SCHEMA] 1 2 met
